meta.title: Optimize dataset storage with pyarrow
meta.body_summary: Implement PyArrow-based incremental checkpoint storage with deduplication, using a central dataset for unique records and an index, to reduce storage footprint and improve debugging.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor implemented PyArrow checkpoint with deduplication; maintainer closed stating 'Does'nt work', indicating functional failure, no benchmark or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5915 changed lines across 11 files with major refactoring in checkpoint_manager.py (1823 lines), this is a large change by absolute volume. It represents a significant architectural refactor for storage optimization. The PR was closed without merge due to functional failure, consistent with high churn that may introduce integration issues.

core_change_summary.description: Introduce PyArrow-based CheckpointManager with deduplication: store unique records centrally and use an index for references, replacing separate JSON files per operation. Supports incremental storage via single dataset. Added checkpoint inspection docs and tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Several documentation and example files were added and then removed or iterated; lockfile changes likely from pyarrow dependency addition.
change_trajectory: Initial addition of PyArrow checkpoint manager (checkpoint_manager.py, checkpoint_utils.py, runner.py changes, research doc).
Refactor to single dataset approach (removed checkpoint_utils.py, simplified manager, added example script and tests).
Added and iterated on documentation for intermediate outputs.
Removed research doc and example script.
Maintainer commits to update pyproject and lockfile, and a final 'update' commit to checkpoint_manager.py.
